name: St Helena Fishcake
desc: A flat, crisp-edged patty of tuna, potato and onion, pan-fried and served hot: the dish the Saints eat on every occasion, in at least a hundred slightly different versions. Restores 140 HP.

name: St Helena Coffee
desc: Green Tipped Bourbon Arabica, grown on the island's hills since the East India Company brought the first plants in 1733. A small harvest, picked and dried by hand. Restores 160 HP.

name: Willow Sprig
desc: A cutting from the willow trees that shade Napoleon's empty tomb in Sane Valley. Napoleon was buried here in 1821 and taken to Paris in 1840, and the willows stayed.
msg: {name} felt the calm of the willows!
